fact: Algerie Telecom and Huawei announced the official launch of the national 400G WDM project, building an all-optical transmission foundation covering the whole country (vendor/PR-wire copy; as_of is the article's published date as it gives none).
Algerie360 reports Algeria has a national fibre optic network of 260,000 km covering 95% of the territory.
L'Echo d'Algerie says Algerie Telecom has deployed nearly 300,000 km of cable across all wilayas, in metropolises and remote areas.
Algerie Telecom's CEO says the group has finalised nearly 300,000 km of backbone fibre covering all of the country's wilayas.
Algerie Telecom's CEO says the backbone provides the mobile operators with the capacity they need to develop their networks.
Algerie Telecom says its fibre made available to operators exceeds 40,000 km, offered through leased lines and irrevocable rights of use.
